title: draining soap dishes
text: draining soap dishes. I bought these to put on my granite counter top to try and mitigate some of the water off the granite... I put my soap dispenser bottle on one.. the dish soap on another and the other I put until the faucet handle.  I set them a little off the edge of the sink.  It is a perfect fix, but I think it helps some. The water drains away and into the sink - mostly.  I just think there is no real way to keep the water away from the granite completely.  They are a sturdy silicone or silicone like material.  They mostly stay put. They wash up easily and nicely. If you were using them strictly as made for - a soap dish - I can't imagine you would be happy with them.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful
